title: Pesto Chicken Penne Casserole
description: Creamy, flavorful and so easy to fix. This meal-in-one will wow family and friends.

steps.text: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish. Combine the bread crumbs, Parmesan cheese, and olive oil in a small bowl until evenly moistened; set aside.

Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the penne, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink.

Meanwhile, combine the chicken in a bowl with the Italian cheese blend, spinach, tomatoes, alfredo sauce, pesto sauce, and milk. Stir in the pasta once done, and scoop into the prepared baking dish. Top with the bread crumb mixture.
Bake in the preheated oven until bubbly and golden brown on top, 40 to 45 minutes.

video.description: This video shows you how to make a quick-and-easy, creamy chicken pesto. Prepared pesto and Alfredo sauces combine with cubed chicken, tomatoes, spinach, and Italian cheeses to create an impressive one-dish meal you bake in the oven. Topped with a bread crumb and Parmesan cheese mixture, the casserole comes out of the oven bubbly and beautifully golden brown. And the best part: it’s even better on day two!
